subject: Exec benchmark roadmap & deliverables for close — MAP v2
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@novaai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-01T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP v2 + proposed benchmarking scope and timeline

Hi Elaine —

Following up from our demo last week. Per our mutual action plan (MAP) discussion, attached is MAP_v2_NovaAI.xlsx with the updated milestones and owners. Key asks from Redwood for the benchmark window:

- Target sequences and representative prompt sets (you already shared a sample; please confirm final set by 05/04)
- Target concurrency pattern: steady-state 50 qps for front-end inference, 200 concurrent KV cache warmers (we'll simulate)
- Success criteria: p50 latency < 120ms TTFT, p95 < 450ms for 2k token responses; throughput measured as tokens/sec sustained for 30m windows

Deliverables we will provide into the MAP:
- CSV of raw latency/throughput traces (nova_benchmark_results_v1.csv)
- Executive readout slides (exec_readout_slides_v1.pptx)
- Dashboard snapshot and an interactive Redwood dashboard link

Proposed timeline:
- 05/04: Final prompt set and test credentials from NovaAI
- 05/06–05/08: Redwood runs directed benchmarks (latency, TTFT, concurrency sweep)
- 05/10: Draft results + CSV share
- 05/12: Executive readout + close alignment call (contingent on results)

Can you confirm the prompt set timeline and whether procurement needs an earlier cost estimate?

Thanks,
Sergio
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: MAP_v2_NovaAI.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Also, Tom (vendor) will share a small sample of production traces to help with simulation fidelity.

Subject: RE: MAP v2 + proposed benchmarking scope and timeline

Sergio/Marissa —

We got the frozen prompt set this morning. Kicking off the benchmark run plan:

Plan summary (05/06–05/08):
- 05/06: Baseline single-client latency sweep (1–8 tokens, 64–2048 context) to measure kernel perf and TTFT behavior
- 05/07: Concurrency sweep (1–200 qps, step 25) with warm KV cache and cold-start runs mixed in
- 05/08: Long-run throughput (30m windows) to capture token/sec and tail latency under sustained load

Data outputs:
- Raw traces CSV (timestamps, request_id, model_variant, seq_len, TTFT_ms, token_rate) -> nova_benchmark_results_v1.csv
- Aggregated slides: p50/p90/p95 latency tables, throughput curves, cost-per-token sensitivity chart -> exec_readout_slides_v1.pptx

I'll include stubbed Redwood dashboard panels and a snapshot image for the MAP. If we hit any regression vs your target, we'll annotate with possible tuning (batch size, quant profile).

Karthik
Lead, Performance Engineering

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Draft benchmark CSV + preliminary readout (please review)

Elaine —

We completed the directed runs. Draft results are attached (nova_benchmark_results_v1.csv) and I've uploaded the interactive dashboard at: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/NovaAI-benchmark-12453

Headline findings (preliminary):
- TTFT p50: 98ms, p95: 420ms for 1.8k token median payloads under steady 50 qps
- Sustained throughput: 14.2k tokens/sec across a 30m window on the dedicated profile we ran
- Concurrency behavior: performance curve stays flat until ~120 concurrent streams; beyond that, p95 increases sharply (600–900ms) without KV-cache tuning
- Cost note: projected unit cost with current quant profile is ~0.6x of your current provider for the same workload

Attachments: nova_benchmark_results_v1.csv, dashboard_snapshot-may12.png

Next steps I propose:
- 05/12 10:00am PT: 30-minute exec readout (we'll present slides + ask for close decision)
- Post-readout: finalize reserved capacity profile and procurement SOW

Quick ask: can you confirm executive availability for 05/12 10:00am PT?

Thanks,
Sergio

From: Elaine Park <elaine@novaai.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Draft benchmark CSV + preliminary readout (please review)

Sergio —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Initial read of the CSV looks promising — p50 well under our target, p95 close to target. Execs are available 05/12 10:00am PT for the readout. Procurement still needs the ballpark monthly cost to attach to the SOW; can Marissa or Lauren drop that into the MAP spreadsheet before 05/12?

Elaine
